provenance.notes: Explicit-import candidate for the existing source identity. Rejects the observed provider-declared incomplete paid preview response; does not decode full-content resources or claim account entitlement. Core and native acceptance remain separate.

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var response = JSON.parse(String(result));
var novel = response && response.data && response.data.novel;
if (!novel || typeof novel.content !== "string" || !novel.content.trim()) {
  throw new Error("来源未返回可用正文");
}
var content = novel.content;
var actualCount = Array.from(content).length;
var countField = novel.word_sum;
var validCount = (typeof countField === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(countField) && countField > 0) ||
  (typeof countField === "string" && /^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(countField) && Number.isSafeInteger(Number(countField)));
var hasFullReference = typeof novel.content_url === "string" && novel.content_url.trim().length > 0;
var paidStatus = novel.price_status === "1" || novel.price_status === 1;
if (paidStatus && actualCount <= 100 && validCount && Number(countField) > actualCount && hasFullReference) {
  throw new Error("当前书源只返回试读内容，未取得完整正文");
}
content;
</js>
